native_capture.route: Existing Godot Project Manager and editor operated using supported CUA only. Exact native_launcher directory imported. Game Embed Mode set Disabled, editor reloaded, setting visually verified, then Run Project. A separate visible native X11 window rendered captures.

visual_review.observations: Both irises visibly shift toward screen-right with narrowed lids and unequal brows, then return to centered exact-neutral appearance. The mouth remains neutral/sealed, body and hair stay fixed. The pose reads as a restrained lateral look; the unsupported downturned mouth corner from the source is absent. Fine lash/hair boundary artifacts are visible in the frozen rig neutral and active detail images and were not retouched.
